cases.expected: Iterator returned by AXFR() should be an instance of ZoneIterator and its internal AXFR flag must be true.
cases.description: Verify that AXFR() creates a ZoneIterator with the AXFR mode enabled.
When the Zone is newly created and contains no RRsets, the iterator returned by AXFR() must be empty.

input.value: RRset containing an A record for www.example.com

cases.expected: hasNext() == true for the first call, next() returns the added RRset, subsequent hasNext() == false.
cases.description: After adding a single RRset to the Zone, AXFR() must iterate over exactly that RRset.

value: RRset containing SOA record for example.com
RRset containing NS record for example.com
RRset containing A record for www.example.com

cases.expected: Iterator yields the three RRsets in the order they were added, then hasNext() == false.
cases.description: When multiple RRsets are added, AXFR() must return an iterator that traverses all of them in insertion order.

cases.expected: Calling remove() on the iterator throws UnsupportedOperationException.
cases.description: The iterator returned by AXFR() is read‑only; any attempt to remove elements via the iterator must raise an exception.

value: RRset containing SOA record for example.com
RRset containing NS record for example.com
RRset containing A record for host1.example.com

input.value: RRset containing A record for host2.example.com

cases.expected: Iterator returned by AXFR() yields only the three RRsets present at the time of iterator creation; the RRset added after obtaining the iterator is not returned.
cases.description: Verify that the AXFR iterator works on a snapshot of the zone state and does not reflect RRsets added after the iterator is created.

value: RRset containing A record for host1.example.com

input.value: Remove the RRset containing A record for host1.example.com

cases.expected: Iterator still returns the originally added RRset despite its removal from the zone after iterator creation; subsequent calls to hasNext() after the single element is consumed return false.
cases.description: Confirm that removing RRsets after obtaining an AXFR iterator does not affect the elements already captured by the iterator.
Calling AXFR() on a null reference of Zone should throw NullPointerException.
If the Zone's internal data structures (e.g., the record map) are uninitialized or corrupted, invoking hasNext() or next() on the iterator returned by AXFR() should throw IllegalStateException.
